name: Table
intro: Compose native table parts inside Root. Use column indices for machine-driven sorting and stacked cell labels.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Renders a div around the native table and an automatic sort status region. Native table props apply to the inner table.

props.name: captionText
props.description: Caption text for table sorting status.

props.name: columnNames
props.description: Accessible names for column indices. Every sortable ColumnHeader requires a nonempty matching entry.

props.name: sortDescriptor
props.description: Controlled sort state. Use null for an unsorted table and reorder your rows to match.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Receives sorting requests. Update sortDescriptor and the row order together.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keeps the header visible while scrolling.

props.name: columnIndex
props.description: Connects this heading to the sorting machine.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Renders a sort button when columnIndex is supplied.

parts.name: Cell
parts.description: Displays one value. Supply data-label for a stacked cell heading.

props.name: columnIndex
props.description: Connects this cell to the active sorted column.

data.value: Present for cells in the sorted column

parts.name: ScrollArea
parts.description: Wraps the table in a horizontally scrollable region.

parts.name: SrStatus
parts.description: Announces sort changes. Root renders this part automatically; do not add a second status region.

accessibility: Provide a caption and column headings. Handle onSortChange in the data source so sorted rows match the announced sort state.
